ApprovalState.description: Current promotion/revocation row; retained approval snapshots are provenance only.
ApprovalState.title: ApprovalState

ArtifactRef.description: Public immutable object-version identity; neither location nor access authority.
ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

BuiltinSource.description: Real trusted repository/build inputs; never a fabricated uploaded package.
BuiltinSource.title: BuiltinSource

IsolationEvidence.description: Current trusted policy/capability observation; constructing it proves no isolation.
IsolationEvidence.title: IsolationEvidence

LockResolutionEvidence.description: Actual trusted lock interpretation; digest equality alone does not prove pinned inputs.
LockResolutionEvidence.title: LockResolutionEvidence

ObjectVerification.description:
Trusted complete stored-byte readback, not object user metadata or a client claim.

The producer verifies the entire raw byte stream at this exact generation,
with transport checksum validation where supported. This message does not do I/O.
ObjectVerification.title: ObjectVerification

OriginalExecutionAdmission.description: Original atomic producer record, never assembled from a launch caller's current values.
OriginalExecutionAdmission.title: OriginalExecutionAdmission

PackageInspection.description: Trusted bounded full-archive inspection; not an extractor or proof by construction.
PackageInspection.title: PackageInspection

PackageManifest.description:
Detached JSON manifest: syntax/profile only, never an import or Agent conformance test.

message_sha256 of this complete parsed manifest is agent_package_sha256 in
CreateRunRequest and CheckpointBinding, distinct from raw archive, detached
manifest, lock and OCI image hashes.

The source archive does not contain this generation-bearing manifest, avoiding
a self-referential archive hash. Configuration-dependent Agent.identity is
retained in original run admission, separately from this package entrypoint.
PackageManifest.title: PackageManifest

PackageObjectRecord.description: Workspace/package ownership; no fabricated run ID.
PackageObjectRecord.title: PackageObjectRecord

PackagePolicy.description: Explicit producer/predecode/cumulative caps; these are not deployment defaults.
PackagePolicy.title: PackagePolicy

PackageSource.description: Trusted producer parsed actual verified detached manifest bytes into manifest.
PackageSource.title: PackageSource

RunOwnership.description: Immutable admission record; creator leaf credentials are audit metadata only.
RunOwnership.title: RunOwnership

RuntimeInstance.description: Provider identity is private and trusted; no client URL or command.
RuntimeInstance.title: RuntimeInstance

StorageLocator.description: Private configured namespace and server-assigned key; no client URL or credentials.
StorageLocator.title: StorageLocator

VerifiedBuildEvidence.description: Real build/provenance verifier output. No unsigned client attestation is accepted.
VerifiedBuildEvidence.title: VerifiedBuildEvidence

WorkerControlClaims.description: Verified internal claims, never a public/service/run credential scope.
WorkerControlClaims.title: WorkerControlClaims

WorkerControlPolicy.description: Internal control identity policy, independent of worker admission/isolation policy.
WorkerControlPolicy.title: WorkerControlPolicy

WorkerLaunchLookup.description:
Keyed authoritative lookup; partial projections remain representable for recovery.

A matching key does not prove absence. Atomic unique attempt admission is required.
WorkerLaunchLookup.title: WorkerLaunchLookup

WorkerLaunchRecord.description: Immutable launch intent and retained provenance; logical running is not a process.
WorkerLaunchRecord.title: WorkerLaunchRecord

WorkerLaunchReplay.description: Metadata only: never token material, a launch directive or artifact payload authority.
WorkerLaunchReplay.title: WorkerLaunchReplay

WorkerLifecycleTransition.description: Pure transition shape, not authorization or a successful process mutation.
WorkerLifecycleTransition.title: WorkerLifecycleTransition

WorkerTerminationCompletion.description: Per-launch acknowledgement only. It never changes a current lease or global run state.
WorkerTerminationCompletion.title: WorkerTerminationCompletion

WorkerTerminationEvidence.description: Trusted exact-instance stop or fenced never-started reconciliation.
WorkerTerminationEvidence.title: WorkerTerminationEvidence
